summary: The isolated terminal test client consumes bounded device commands, signs purpose-bound visible-state results, displays the active run, and offers a global enrollment revoke key.

replay.detail: No replay changes; commands remain ephemeral.

schema.detail: Consumes the shared client-control result and grant schema.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule changes or enrollment effects.

compatibility.detail: Normal terminal clients do not subscribe to commands; fixture control requires an explicit separate paired profile.

manual.detail: Fixture setup and initial test-client enrollment require separate approvals. Use the isolated client socket, dedicated profile and narrow read-plus-command scopes.

recovery.detail: Revoke test-client enrollment and revert the source change; preserve normal pairings.
